Record notes

Reusable visual templates with source-bound design handoffs, token checks and small adaptation recipes.

Version 0.1.6 includes 1 complete skill procedures. Complete runtime, source chooser and token checks; private template collection excluded.

Requirements: Python 3.12 and declared MCP dependencies; Your own authorized template collection.

License scope: AGPL-3.0-only AND CC-BY-SA-4.0; retained upstream licenses as scoped in LICENSE-SCOPE.json. Read the packaged notices and provenance before reuse.

Install with codex plugin add design-templates@working-tools after adding JonathanKHobson/working-tools-plugins, or the documented Claude Code marketplace path. Installation and tested compatibility.
